title: LedZ Civ V3.3
features:
I would appreciate if u join the discord, features:

Player › Movement
- Speed Boost (+ Speed Multiplier, Speed Jitter)
- No Slow (kills crouch/knock/aim/stationary slowdowns)
- Infinite Jump
- CFrame Fly — WASD + Space/Shift (+ Fly Speed)
- Noclip (walk through walls)
- Ghost — stealth CFrame ground-speed (+ Ghost Speed, Ghost Stealth 1–4)
- CFrame Speed — jittered movement on top of walking (+ amount)
- CFrame Fly (noclip + jitter) (+ speed)

Player › Survival
- Infinite Water (auto-drink, direct)
- Auto Hunger (auto-eats food)
- Auto Prompts (+ Respect Hold Time)
- Keep Backpack Open
- Anti-Grab (breaks foreign carry welds)

Player › Visuals
- Player ESP — Names+Distance, Boxes, Health bars, Chams, Distance slider
- Town ESP — real civ names from the town hall's Team value (+ label growth)
- Rock ESP — Stone/Gold/Marble/Copper nodes, Map.Resources.Rocks or Direct Workspace scan (+ distance)
- Loot ESP (dropped items) — tools-only pickups on the ground: Show Item dropdown (lists each dropped tool by name + count, or All Items), Show Distance toggle, Loot ESP Distance slider, Refresh Loot List button
- Hitbox Expander — Show Box, Hitbox Size, Box Transparency

Combat › Fight
- Spear Silent Aim (+ Prediction, Prediction Lead, Aim Range, Team Check, Auto Throw)
- Buttons: Throw At Nearest, Shield Up, Shield Down, Kick Shields, Toggle Friendly Fire
- Auto Combat — Auto Kick (when they shield), Auto Shield (when they attack), range
- Auto-Equip Strongest Weapon When Hit
- Panic — Safe Now (rise), Auto Panic Rise (low HP), Stay Up (hover), HP Threshold, Rise Height

Combat › Ghost
- Ghost Kill (follow target; underneath = noclip under terrain, above = no-clip)
- Go Above toggle, Visible Hitbox, Target Hitbox Radius

World › Deploy
- Plant Near Me
- Plant Where I Stand — plants at your feet, air-fallback if the spot's rejected
- Plant At Town Root — plants at the nearest town hall's center
- Place at Mouse (click)
- Auto-Plant Around You (+ Auto Radius) — no more town bias, air-fallback placement
- Ring Town Hall (+ Ring Radius, Ring Count)

World › Trader
- Trade All Affordable (once), Auto-Trade Affordable, interval

World › Jobs
- Create My Own Civ
- Join Team / Civ dropdown (+ Refresh Teams)
- Pick Job dropdown — auto-hops to a job board (+ Refresh Job List)

World › Misc
- Withdraw All From Storage (empties an open chest at once)
- Announcement Logger (rolling leader-announcement history + Clear)
- Unload
